title: Red Line relay moisture bulletin
summary: Signal teams will inspect relay cabinets after overnight rain near Harbor Junction.
body: Controllers reported intermittent relay alarms and manual routing through the junction cabinet. Crews will stabilize the signal cabinet, trace moisture ingress, and confirm controller reset logs before morning pullout.

title: Blue Line drainage pump follow-up
summary: Track crews will drain flooded ballast pockets and inspect pump output near Bay Station.
body: Heavy rainfall left saturated ballast and standing water beside the blue line turnout. Maintenance teams will drain the trench, reinforce fasteners, and verify drainage pump telemetry before normal service resumes.

title: Green Line substation charger recovery
summary: Electrical specialists will restore backup charger coverage after feeder switching.
body: A delayed breaker response left the portable charger bank isolated during the midday window. Power crews will rebalance feeder loads, energize the charger rack, and monitor voltage stability at the south substation.

title: Gold Line crowd management notice
summary: Station staff will direct peak crowd queues with temporary boarding lanes downtown.
body: Event traffic is expected to crowd the central platform after the evening game. Customer teams will stage shuttle support, update wayfinding signs, and broadcast boarding announcements for accessible routing.

title: Silver Line coastal wind restriction
summary: Operations managers issued a weather alert because severe coastal gusts reduced bridge visibility.
body: Persistent wind and spray will delay normal speeds across the elevated segment. Dispatchers may reroute trains, shelter staff on exposed platforms, and reopen full service once visibility sensors recover.

title: Red Line signal cabinet replacement
summary: Field crews will replace a faulty controller cabinet and recalibrate the interlocking relay tree.
body: The current cabinet has repeated controller resets and intermittent beacon faults. Engineers will replace relay trays, calibrate automatic routes, and validate redundant signal behavior before the next peak period.

title: Blue Line overnight rail grinding plan
summary: Maintenance teams scheduled rail grinding and fastener tightening on the curved approach.
body: Track geometry data showed uneven wear through the coastal curve. Crews will grind the worn rail, tighten fasteners, measure the junction alignment, and reopen the corridor before first train.

title: Green Line heat advisory for substations
summary: Power supervisors will monitor transformer temperature during the persistent heat wave.
body: The summer heat increased charger demand and strained backup battery cabinets. Electrical teams will monitor voltage drift, balance substation loads, and stage portable cooling near the transformer room.
